variants.optimizerInput: Aqua Study Station, Desks & Tech, Tier 3, Galaxy Glow. Create ONE isolated study desk only. Use one broad gently curved aqua-and-cream worktop, one compact left storage pedestal with drawers, two clear weight-bearing supports, one shallow attached monitor/book shelf and a small integrated cable channel. Add restrained cyan-violet galaxy rim lighting and one tiny star/orbit accent. Full desk completely inside frame on a plain studio background with grounded shadow. NO second desk, NO stacked duplicate, NO comparison view, NO collage, NO room scene, NO chair, NO floating panels, NO text or logos.

Aqua Study Station, Desks & Tech, Tier 3, Galaxy Glow. Design ONE clean functional study station with a single rectangular-to-soft-curve desktop, two stable side supports, one small drawer cabinet, and one physically attached upper shelf. Use pale aqua, navy and soft violet accents with premium matte wood/metal/acrylic separation. Keep the product silhouette simple and instantly readable at Store-card size. NO duplicate furniture, NO stacked versions, NO split-screen, NO collage, NO room walls, NO floating hardware, NO text.

Ocean Window, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Candy Core. Create ONE wall-mounted recessed window object with a thick rounded candy-coral frame, aqua inner trim and a single crystal-clear glazed opening showing an unmistakable blue ocean horizon with water, sky and subtle waves. Show frame thickness, recessed wall depth, small mounting reveal and soft wall-cast shadow. Add only restrained pastel candy accents around the frame. Full object isolated on a neutral wall plane. NO grid, NO cubbies, NO shelving, NO abstract circuit pattern, NO multiple windows, NO room scene, NO text or logos.

Ocean Window, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Candy Core. Design ONE large rounded-rectangle ocean-view wall window with a substantial cream-and-pink frame, aqua glazing edge, visible sill depth and a bright ocean scene clearly visible through the glass: blue water, horizon and soft cloud sky. Use playful Candy Core trim but keep the window opening dominant. Three-quarter wall-mounted view with believable recess and shadow. NO mosaic, NO grid, NO decorative panel wall, NO repeated openings, NO text.

Art Gallery Wall, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Adventure Club. Create ONE compact wall-mounted gallery product with EXACTLY THREE large framed artworks attached to one shallow warm-oak backboard. Every frame must contain obvious visible art: left = mountain trail landscape, center = compass/route-map geometric artwork, right = colorful travel-map/path abstraction. Use clear frame bevels, glass reflections, small brass clips and visible backboard thickness. The three artworks must occupy almost the entire silhouette and remain readable at Store-card size. NO fourth frame, NO shelves, NO cubbies, NO blank panels, NO ledge, NO plants, NO floor furniture, NO room scene, NO text.

Art Gallery Wall, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Adventure Club. Make ONE wall-hung triptych: exactly three oversized mixed-size frames on a single slim backing plate, each with distinct Adventure Club artwork—mountain path, compass rose geometry and stylized travel-route map. Use one cohesive warm oak/brass construction with wall standoffs and soft cast shadow. Strong framed-art silhouette, no empty frame areas, full object centered with negative space. NO shadowbox, NO shelves, NO grid, NO extra relief panels, NO floor/room context, NO text.

Luxe Command Desk, Desks & Tech, Tier 5, Star Luxe. Create ONE isolated premium command desk as the entire product on a plain studio background. Use a wide gently curved midnight-navy worktop with brushed-gold edge, exactly two substantial side supports, integrated drawer/equipment cabinet, one shallow raised monitor bridge and a centered control surface. Add restrained star-shaped gold inlays and smoked-glass/acrylic accents. Full desk silhouette completely inside frame with generous negative space and grounded shadow. NO wall cabinets, NO built-in shelving, NO room architecture, NO chair, NO cockpit enclosure, NO duplicate desk, NO text.

Luxe Command Desk, Desks & Tech, Tier 5, Star Luxe. Design ONE freestanding executive-tech desk with a broad dark-blue desktop, gold-edged structural legs/pylons, integrated side storage and one attached slim display shelf. Include a small coherent command/control pad and subtle crystal-star detailing embedded in the desk, not floating. Premium satin metal, lacquered wood and smoked glass, heroic three-quarter product view, clear floor contact. NO wall unit, NO upper cabinets, NO room scene, NO multiple desks, NO throne/cockpit, NO text.
